name: secskills-offense
description: Attacker tradecraft with the judgment, not just the commands. 38 offensive security skills for red teams and pentesters: web/API/auth exploitation (JWT, OAuth/OIDC, SAML, XXE, SSRF, deserialization, GraphQL, gRPC), Active Directory and Entra ID, AD CS ESC1-16, Kerberos delegation, Linux/Windows privilege escalation, cloud, managed Kubernetes, serverless, CI/CD, containers, mobile, wireless, Bluetooth/NFC, ICS/OT, Web3, reconnaissance, social engineering, persistence, and password cracking — plus deception-spotting and multi-day engagement discipline. Every skill fact-checked against primary sources. Pairs with secskills-core. Use when pentesting, red-teaming, or exploiting a target.
